create_llm_resource_client: create an LLMResourceClient to send messages to an LLM model via query_llm.make_request
utilize_llm_resource_client: utilize an LLMResourceClient to make async LLM requests with sampling and tool parameters
create_container_resource_client: create a ContainerResourceClient to manage container lifecycle with start and execution config
acquire_container: acquire a container with retry logic and exponential backoff using ContainerResourceClient
release_container: release an acquired container by its container_id using ContainerResourceClient
